description: This file defines the UtilCodec class, providing various encoding, decoding, and sanitization utilities for different content types (HTML, XML, URL, String) used within the Ofbiz framework. It handles security measures like XSS prevention and HTML sanitization and includes policies for safe HTML rendering and user input validation.

classes.name: UtilCodec.HtmlEncoder
classes.description: Encodes strings into HTML entities and provides a sanitization method with configurable policies.

classes.name: UtilCodec.XmlEncoder
classes.description: Encodes strings into XML entities and sanitizes input accordingly.

classes.name: UtilCodec.UrlCodec
classes.description: Provides URL encoding and decoding functionalities.

classes.name: UtilCodec.StringEncoder
classes.description: Encodes strings by escaping quotes for safe inclusion in Java strings.

classes.name: UtilCodec.HtmlEncodingMapWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a Map to provide HTML encoding of string values transparently.

classes.name: UtilCodec
classes.description: Contains static utility methods for encoding, decoding, and sanitizing input in various formats, with security-focused checks and policies.

methods.name: getEncoder
methods.description: Returns an encoder instance based on the specified type ('html', 'xml', 'url', 'string').

methods.name: getDecoder
methods.description: Returns a decoder instance for the specified type ('url').

methods.name: canonicalize
methods.description: Performs canonicalization and validation to prevent injection attacks, handling multiple encoding layers.

methods.name: encodeUrl
methods.description: Encodes URL query strings following OFBiz rules.

methods.name: checkStringForHtmlStrictNone
methods.description: Performs a strict blacklist check on a string for HTML content, including character validation and JavaScript event detection.

methods.name: checkStringForHtmlSafe
methods.description: Validates if a string is safe HTML according to custom policies and sanitization, reporting errors otherwise.
